---
# One-page CV. Content comes from cv.qmd; blocks marked
# `.content-visible when-meta="onepage"` / `unless-meta="onepage"` there
# switch between the full and condensed versions.
onepage: true

# Curated publications (keys from references.bib), overriding `nocite: @*`
# in _quarto.yml. New ORCID works are NOT added here automatically -- add
# their key to show them on the one-page CV.
nocite: |
  @longworth2022radiocarbon, @longworth2015injector, @longworth2013carbonate, @longworth2007lithology

csl: nature.csl

format:
  typst:
    margin:
      x: 0.5in
      y: 0.4in
  html: default
---

{{< include cv.qmd >}}
